description: GENERAL PROPOSITIONAL DEDUCTION through the inference_generation collapse pipeline (DEDUCTION_GENERALIZATION_PREREG.md / DEDUCTION_GENERALIZATION_RESULTS.md). seeds/inference_knowledge.json already supplies 5 kinds of world-knowledge schema (knowledge_enabling/elaborative/partwhole/goal/causal) the gap-driven inference generator (domains/inference_generation.py) decodes gaps against, via the SAME ShapeDecode collapse reading_collapse.py uses for construction recognition. This seed adds a SIXTH kind, 'knowledge_logical': a HELD IMPLICATION (an antecedent held-predicate over an object => a consequent value) represented as graph data, mirroring the antecedent/consequent separation domains/ground_reductions.py's ImplicationClause/GroundedReduction ALREADY proves works for propositional deduction (real, executing modus ponens over group-theory theorems) -- reused here as the MODEL for the semantics, not the implementation (ground_reductions.py itself is untouched; its Python-callable antecedents are domain-bound to free-product structure and cannot read arbitrary graph facts). A knowledge_logical schema's `signature` is the antecedent fact pattern `[["holds", <antecedent_attr>]]` (the SAME structural-pattern-match discipline every other knowledge_* schema already uses, decoded via Covers, not executed as a callable); its `supplies` is the consequent, in the BYTE-IDENTICAL `{"relation": "is_a", "attr": ...}` shape knowledge_enabling schemas already use, so the mint reuses situation_model_reader.ingest_predication UNCHANGED (the exact call resolve_precondition_gap already makes). Node type stays ShapeSignature (per SHAPE_TYPE_VOCABULARY_SPIKE.md's corrected finding: node TYPE partitions a decode pool, kind is a label within it -- a new kind is an ADDITION to the existing pool, not a new mechanism). HONEST SCOPE: single-antecedent-attribute implications only (no conjunctive antecedents, no quantifiers, no negation/modus-tollens) -- propositional modus-ponens-shaped inference, one antecedent fact => one consequent fact, exactly the class of theorem-implication ground_reductions.py already proves executable, generalized past group theory. The KNOWLEDGE below is finite and hand-seeded (the same discipline seeds/inference_knowledge.json's own description states for its 8 schemas: 'the KNOWLEDGE is finite and seeded; the MECHANISM is general'); domains/propositional_deduction.py additionally lets the agent MINT a schema of this same shape from ordinary conditional prose ('if X is a bird, X can fly') at runtime -- CORRECTED 2026-08-13 (see docs/research/engine_substrate/DEDUCTION_GENERAL_READER_CORRECTION_RESULTS.md) to ingest that prose through the GENERAL reading pipeline (reading_collapse.py's decompose_sentence/read_clause -- the SAME construction-decode machinery every other sentence in the corpus already uses) rather than a second, independent construction-grammar mini-parser, which the first landing of this seed's own description used to say and which duplicated a capability the general reader already had. comprehend_theorem.py stays untouched and group-theory-scoped, unrelated to this correction.
